newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso firmer ahead of unemployment data.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso firmer ahead of unemployment data.

text.p: The Mexican peso extended early gains at midmorning trade on Wednesday after dealers sold long dollar positions on a favorable outlook for unemployment data, traders said.
"Dollars are very much on offer, they're selling long dollar positions, but I feel the peso will not firm beyond 7.9100-per-dollar," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart both stood 1.6 centavos firmer on the day at 7.9110/7.9140 and 7.9080/7.9110 per dollar, respectively.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed trade for the day 3.1 centavos firmer at 7.9050/7.9080 per dollar.
